integrity: A characteristic-independent algebraic determinant proof is supplied; a standalone standard-library finite-field checker corroborates the determinant and incidence profile for Q=2,3,4,5,7,8. Finite checks do not imply the universal assertion.
scientific_limitations: The complete-intersection equivalence applies only to centers outside every rational secant plane; the factorization is for the specified conic directions and equal Artin–Schreier orbits, not arbitrary Artin–Schreier configurations. No independence or external validation is asserted.
title: External-line factorization of the exceptional projection locus for Artin–Schreier conic configurations
